record.question: Prepare 3rd Running and Final Bill showing Memorandum of payment of Contractor ABC for the work 'Construction of High Court Building at Aizawl' from the following: Items: (1) Earthwork in foundation - cum - Quantity 248, Rate Rs. 200, Previous bill 20; (2) Laying of Cement concrete - cum - Quantity 180, Rate Rs. 3,600, Previous bill 90; (3) RCC Work - cum - Quantity 40, Rate Rs. 5,650, Previous bill 21; (4) Brick work - Sqm - Quantity 154, Rate Rs. 800, Previous bill 52; (5) Providing & Fixing doors - Sqm - Quantity 20, Rate Rs. 4,320, Previous bill —. Details of recoveries: (a) 10% of Security deposit to be deducted from this Running accounts Bill (b) 2% Income Tax to be deducted from value of work done (c) Cost of material issued for this work Rs. 20,000 (d) Cost of material issued for another work Rs. 10,800
